req.title: Update pre-populates form
req.statement: The system shall pre-fill the update form with the existing post's title and body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the update form should be pre-filled with the existing post's title and body. This behavior needs to be verified through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_update_form_prefill_positive
preconditions: A post exists with a known title and body
actions: Access the update endpoint for the existing post
expected: Form pre-filled with the post's title and body
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Setup: Register and login a user
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})

# Setup: Create a post
client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Test Title', 'body': 'Test Body'})

# Action: Access the update form
r = client.get('/1/update')

# Assertions
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Test Title' in r.data
assert b'Test Body' in r.data

tests.name: test_update_form_prefill_negative
preconditions: A post exists with a known title and body
actions: Attempt to access the update endpoint for the existing post
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Setup: Register and login a user
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})
client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})

# Setup: Create a post
client.post('/create', data={'title': 'Test Title', 'body': 'Test Body'})

# Action: Logout
client.get('/auth/logout')

# Action: Attempt to access the update form
r = client.get('/1/update')

# Assertions
assert r.status_code == 302
assert '/auth/login' in r.headers['Location']
